# Purpose
This file records legal notices, source attributions, and license terms for third-party code and data used in the codebase. It identifies which local components are derived from external projects, such as `xxHash`, `OpenSSL`, `Go`, `NIST`, `LLVM`, `BLAKE3`, `cJSON`, `musl`, and others, and it names the local paths that contain the adapted implementations. It also states the license conditions that apply to each imported or modified component, which supports compliance review and distribution of the software. In addition, it documents test vectors and generated assembly sources so that the origin of cryptographic and protocol assets is clear.
